findings.detail: Controlled and non-controlled affiliated investment roll-up totals were included with position detail, adding $355,919,417 above the schedule total.

rationale: The filing schedule reports total debt and equity investment fair value of $657,323,982. The extracted position sum is $1,013,243,399, an excess of $355,919,417. The raw source roll-up totals are $246,700,365 for controlled affiliated investments and $109,219,052 for non-controlled affiliated investments; together they equal the residual exactly. These aggregate rows duplicate underlying position coverage and establish a subtotal-leak extraction error.
